edits.old: Then the answer is 409 and nothing changes
edits.new:
Then the answer is 409 and nothing changes

  Scenario: AC9 Rules BR1, BR2, BR4, BR6, BR7 (NEWAC-RWB-S8-E7005-APP-AC6)
    Given a deviation row is written with deviation_code X5
    When the decision is recorded and the row changes
    Then the decision is written before the row changes, the prescription date is untouched, the row takes only LOV values, and no personal data enters the row, the log or any call

  Scenario: AC10 Error answers 401, 403 and 404 (NEWAC-RWB-S8-E7005-APP-AC7)
    Given a request to API-S8-001 or API-S8-002 has no valid credential, comes from a role without the Case record right, or names a deviation that does not exist
    When the request is answered
    Then the answer is 401, 403 or 404 for those three cases respectively, with the platform envelope, and nothing changes

  Scenario: AC11 Replay of a write with the same Idempotency-Key (NEWAC-RWB-S8-E7005-APP-AC8)
    Given a write to the deviation has been answered under an Idempotency-Key
    When the same write is sent again with the same Idempotency-Key
    Then the first answer is returned, no second decision record and no second deviation change is written, and the repeat is counted

  Scenario: AC12 Duplicate delivery of a consumed event (NEWAC-RWB-S8-E7005-APP-AC9)
    Given a consumed BANKRUPTCY_FILED event has been applied to the deviation
    When the same event is delivered again
    Then the event produces one effect and the repeat is counted
